svg.title: The field_terms header, version 1
svg.text: (a) the header of a two-date chunk, 80 bytes, little endian
variables A, S, B, C; terms A ← S (intercept) and B ← S, C (no intercept); A is bypassed on date 1
term table: u16 target, u16 k, k × u16 source
coefficients: pred = c0 + c1 s1 + .. + ck sk
(b) in the chunk: one header record of the chain envelope (envelope.md)
to scale: n bytes of stage id, m bytes of header, then zero padding to a multiple of 8; the envelope keeps one such record per stage
frozen (header version 1): every offset, type and order above, the flag bit, and the decoder arithmetic.
not frozen: the coefficients the encoder writes (its fit) and which slices it bypasses.
